title: Chapter 2 · The castle's threat
description: La Reina Bubbaloo's castle on the Rec Comtal school at its most threatening (no ánimas: every spiked tower, thorns, eyes, the storm), then as Gerard and Aitor gather ánimas: the towers fall one by one, and the castle on the network map shrinks with them. Ánimas are added by script (the friends' missions do not exist yet).

steps.caption: Threat 1: twelve spiked towers, thorns, glowing eyes, a storm over the crown
Two ánimas (threat 0.7): the four small outer towers and the glowing eyes are gone

steps.eval: for (const flag of ['anima-nuria', 'anima-uri']) window.gerard.story.flags.delete(flag); window.gerard.game.refreshStory(); undefined
import('/src/map-markers.ts').then(m => { void window.gerard.travelUI.show('trinitat-vella', {}, m.cityMarkers({ castle: true, threat: 1 })) }) && undefined

steps.caption: On the network map: the castle at threat 1

steps.eval: import('/src/map-markers.ts').then(m => { void window.gerard.travelUI.show('trinitat-vella', {}, m.cityMarkers({ castle: true, threat: .25 })) }) && undefined

steps.caption: And with most ánimas gathered (threat 0.25): smaller, fewer towers, no storm
